heroIntroduction: Pharmacy First is available to people in Wombwell, offering NHS consultations for eligible common conditions. This service is provided by Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield, supporting residents of Wombwell and the wider Barnsley area.
localIntroduction: Wombwell is in the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, South Yorkshire. The area features a public library, which hosts local history sessions run by Wombwell Heritage Group. Citizens Advice also holds advice and welfare rights drop-in sessions at the library.
